subject.title: Feature Request: First-class Projects in Gateway Dashboard (workspace + skill scoping + runtime constraints)

question: What is the first supported Project MVP for OpenClaw: a read/write core Project object with dashboard and `projects.*` APIs, a session-category/worktree-only UI improvement, or a plugin/ClawHub experiment before core API work?
rationale: The request is meaningful but cannot be safely reduced to an automated fix because storage shape, protocol surface, UI hierarchy, upgrade behavior, and security semantics are product/API decisions.

options.title: Define a core Project MVP
options.body: Create a maintainer-owned design for a minimal core Project object, additive Gateway API, dashboard surface, and warn-only or enforced constraint semantics before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to session organization
options.body: Track only the immediate session grouping/switching UX in existing sessions/worktrees surfaces and defer durable project constraints.

options.title: Prototype outside core first
options.body: Ask for a plugin or ClawHub experiment if maintainers want proof of workflow value before committing to core storage and protocol.

recommendation.title: Define a core Project MVP
recommendation.body: Create a maintainer-owned design for a minimal core Project object, additive Gateway API, dashboard surface, and warn-only or enforced constraint semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already left the strongest product follow-up signal in the issue discussion and recently touched the session/worktree/dashboard boundary.
